name: Git Ops
description: Close out a local coding task on the bound daemon: stage, commit, branch, merge, and push via cloud git — and when a merge conflicts, STOP and escalate with the file list instead of auto-resolving. Push only reaches the bare replica; prod-triggering tags are refused.

sampleTasks.title: Commit the task's files, branch, merge back, record provenance
sampleTasks.prompt:
Close out the coding task's git work FOR REAL, in an ISOLATED scratch repo under `.e2e-tmp/` (never in the shared worktree — it carries other sessions' uncommitted changes; `git stash` / `git checkout` there is forbidden). Set up: `.e2e-tmp/<name>/work` (a git repo whose `origin` remote is a LOCAL bare replica, e.g. `.e2e-tmp/<name>/replica.git`) plus `.e2e-tmp/<name>/conflict` (a repo with a real merge conflict left IN PROGRESS). Then: stage ONLY the task-owned files (`a.txt`, `b.txt`) with `git add`, commit (`cloud git commit` when a workdir-bound daemon is available, plain `git commit` in the scratch repo otherwise — the oracle is the object store, not the transport), create the scoped branch, push the branch to the bare replica, attempt to push a prod-triggering tag (`k8s-prod-*`) and confirm it does NOT land on the replica, and in the conflict repo STOP at the conflict: list the unmerged files and escalate — do NOT `merge --abort`, `reset`, or `-X ours/theirs`. Finally record branch + sha into the task metadata with `cloud task meta set --set-string`.

--- YOUR REPORT MUST USE THIS MACHINE-CHECKED OUTPUT CONTRACT. Every line below is re-read out of the REAL object store with read-only git plumbing (`cat-file`, `show --name-only`, `rev-parse`, `ls-remote`, `diff --diff-filter=U`), and the task metadata is re-read from the live API:

```
GIT-REPO: .e2e-tmp/<name>/work
GIT-COMMIT: <full sha> | files: a.txt, b.txt
GIT-BRANCH: <branch> | head: <full sha>
GIT-PUSHED: <branch> | remote: origin
GIT-REFUSED-TAG: k8s-prod-<date>-v<x.y.z> | remote: origin
GIT-CONFLICT-REPO: .e2e-tmp/<name>/conflict
GIT-CONFLICT-FILES: c.txt
TASK: <task id>
META: git.sha = <full sha> | type: string
META: git.branch = <branch> | type: string
```

HARD RULES: `files:` must be the EXACT file set of that commit — an extra auto-staged file is caught; `GIT-CONFLICT-FILES` must equal git's unmerged set AND `.git/MERGE_HEAD` must still exist (aborting/resolving destroys that evidence and fails the report); the refused tag must be ABSENT from the replica; `META:` values are compared against what the server actually stored, and `type: string` is a claim about the STORED type, so `--set` number-coercion is caught.
expectedArtifacts: `GIT-REPO` / `GIT-COMMIT … | files:` — the real commit and its exact file set (no auto-staged extras)
`GIT-BRANCH … | head:` and `GIT-PUSHED … | remote:` — branch tip and the local bare replica really carrying it
`GIT-REFUSED-TAG … | remote:` — the prod-triggering tag is absent from the replica
`GIT-CONFLICT-REPO` + `GIT-CONFLICT-FILES` — MERGE_HEAD still alive and the unmerged set equals the escalated list
`TASK:` + `META: git.sha|git.branch … | type: string` — provenance stored as strings

acceptanceCriteria.label: commit / branch / push / refused-tag are re-read out of the real object store: the commit exists and touches EXACTLY the task-owned files, the branch tip is the declared sha, the local bare replica really carries the branch, and the prod-triggering tag is NOT on it
the merge conflict was left IN PLACE and escalated: MERGE_HEAD still exists (so no abort/reset/-X happened) and the declared file list equals git's unmerged set
branch + sha provenance is really on the task and stored as STRINGS (re-read from the live task row; `--set` number-coercion is caught)
push only to allowlisted bare replica remote; no --force

humanApprovalRequiredFor: pushing prod-triggering tags (refused daemon-side; the real gate is GitLab protected tags)
